programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Michael Bolton
programme.sub-title: Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without You?", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.title: Peter Frampton
programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

Meanwhile, Mariah and Cameron try to find ways to fit in at their new school with some unwanted help from Jeff and Rachel.

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: Of Mice and Men
programme.desc: John Malkovich, Gary Sinise and Sherilyn Fenn shine in this contemporary remake of the beloved classic about a nomadic farm worker who looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Superhumans defy a government plot to harness and abuse their powers. Chris Evans and Dakota Fanning (the TWILIGHT films) team in a pulse-pounding paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Big Mommas House
programme.desc: In order to protect a woman from a robber, a male FBI agent disguises himself as an elderly woman.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: A man discovers that he possesses the ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
programme.desc: Clary Fray's search for her missing mother leads her to a dangerous alternate New York called the Shadow World

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: A half-vampire must battle evil immortal vampires and protect her friend from those after her secret power.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: As human blood becomes more scarce, vampires must search for new ways to satisfy their craving.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Three Musketeers
programme.desc: France is in turmoil and a new, naive King finds himself manipulated by the evil Cardinal Richelieu (James Cosmo). With a corrupt commander of the royal guard by his side the Cardinal employs the expertise of the wicked Milady de Winter in a plot to bring down the monarchy. As France burns the Cardinal will take control. All that stands between them and victory are the remnants of an elite group.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: For one family protecting their land on the Texas-Mexico border is everything but an encounter with an immigrant family leads to Jackson accidentally killing a boy. With his father Bill (Frank Grillo - Captain America: The Winter Soldier) attempting to take the blame, Jackson flees and crosses the border into Mexico. Now an illegal alien himself, he faces the very fears he imposed on others.

programme.title: Roxxy
programme.desc: Bonnie and Clyde meets True Romance in this thrilling and electrifying ride. When Vincent (Emile Hirsch: Lone Survivor) saves Roxxy (Zo Kravitz: X-Men: First Class) from a violent assailant, their lives are suddenly transformed and they find themselves on the run. A jaw-dropping action thriller from the makers of Joker. Highly recommended!

programme.title: Giant Killer Ants
programme.desc: From FrightFest Presents. Tremors meets Spinal Tap in this excell-ant monster movie with bite. Starring Sean Astin (Stranger Things) and Tom Arnold. A 1989 one-hit-wonder glam-metal band embark on a trip to the No-chella rock festival in the hopes for a comeback. But a carefree psychedelic pit stop results in them facing an army of flesh-eating ants that keep increasing in size!

programme.title: After The Wedding
programme.desc: Isabel (Michelle Williams) has devoted her life to running an orphanage in a Kolkata slum. With funds running dry, she lands uncomfortably in the sights of a possible benefactor, Theresa Young (Julianne Moore), a multi-millionaire media mogul. Theresa's life couldn't appear to be more perfect.

programme.title: Bee Season
programme.desc: Richard Gere stars in this gripping tale about a father obsessed with training his talented daughter for the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

programme.title: Céline
programme.desc: Céline tells the unforgettable love story of one of the most compelling celebrity couples of all time and chronicles the rise to fame of the world's greatest pop superstar.

programme.title: Merry Kiss Cam
programme.desc: (2022) Festive romcom with Katie Lowes. She's an artist, he's a sports-mad bartender. When their kiss on the Kiss Cam brings their hockey team good luck, fans want them to keep the magic going.

programme.title: A Song For Christmas
programme.desc: Single parents Jennifer and Nate's blossoming relationship is threatened.

programme.title: A Christmas Mission
programme.desc: (2020) Festive romance with Mary Antonini and Michael Xavier. Emma is reluctant to come home for Christmas despite her General dad's wishes. Can an old flame back from active duty change her mind?

programme.title: Falling In Love At Christmas
programme.desc: Business rivals Miranda and Paul unknowingly meet at a Santa themed fancy-dress party. But will their feelings towards each other alter when their identities are revealed? Stars Travis Nelson. (2021)

programme.title: Press Play
programme.desc: A young woman has a chance to save the love of her life when she discovers that the mix-tape they made together can transport her back in time.

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: A Taste of Love
programme.desc: A struggling TV chef returns home to find that her family's restaurant is for sale, not able to compete with contemporary cuisine. Trying to save it, she reconnects with her childhood sweetheart and finds the inspiration she was seeking.

programme.title: Made for You, with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: A Husband for Christmas
programme.desc: Two co-workers agree to a loveless marriage of convenience, but as they become acquainted, an unrealized chemistry grows between them.

programme.title: Manhattan
programme.desc: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Meryl Streep and Mariel Hemingway star in Woody Allen's extraordinary and funny film that explores the embattled life and loves of a successful New York comedy writer.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: A Kind of Magic
programme.desc: Meeting at a Halloween party, Matt and Sara have an instant connection, but they agree to not exchange numbers. What they don't realize is that by meeting, they've set in motion events that will change both their lives in magical ways.

programme.title: Love's Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Not Cinderella's Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Finding Love In Sisters
programme.desc: When her mother dies, Esperanza returns to Sisters, Oregon and reunites with her sisters.

programme.title: Blueprint To The Heart
programme.desc: An interior designer trying to save her home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale "fixer upper" home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: After winning a $50,000 prize, a man decides to pay things forward by buying Christmas gifts for strangers under the pseudonym "Lucky the Elf."

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Holly Logan returns to Gulfport for a Christmas light show.

programme.title: The Christmas Snowman.
programme.desc: Woman's wished-for perfect man comes to life as a snowman.

programme.title: Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Crooks and cops chase siblings with fake cash in Canada. Stars Matthew Knight.

programme.title: A Christmas in Tennessee
programme.desc: Allison, her daughter, and her mother, run a bakery in a small mountain town.

programme.title: Eyewitness
programme.desc: It has been five years after Diana send a man to jail for the murder of her father and fiancee. Then he escapes from prison. He keeps her captive in her own home. Did Diana put an innocent man away?

programme.title: A Lethal Lesson
programme.desc: High school teacher Lauren is accused of an affair by a student, putting her job and life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: Be Mine
programme.desc: A woman finds romance as she prepares to take over her mother's garden store.

programme.title: Funny Lady
programme.desc: FUNNY LADY resumes several years after FUNNY GIRL and chronicles Fanny Brice's relationship--both personal and professional--with second husband, showman Billy Rose.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.desc: For John Clasky (Adam Sandler), life as a celebrity chef means balancing a high-profile career and raising a family. So when his family hires a gorgeous new housekeeper from Mexico, John quickly learns it may be his life that needs translation!

programme.title: Moneyball (2011)
programme.desc: Oakland A's general manager attempts to put together a baseball club on a budget.

programme.title: Moneyball (2011)
programme.desc: Oakland A's general manager attempts to put together a baseball club on a budget.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Tim Allen is Joe, a guy whose life has been steadily changing for the worse. When the office bully goes too far, Joe decides it's time to turn himself from a nobody into a somebody.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

programme.title: 36 Husbands
programme.desc: 36 Husbands is a mystical, musical, Kung Fu spy comedy starring 3 powerful women - and a bunch of husbands. Krista, top spy and Kung Fu master, has extraordinary powers and she puts them in action on her quest to slow down the steady march towards World War III.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid embarks on a dual mission: rescuing a girl from a marriage to a false suitor and tracking down outlaws who robbed a gold-carrying stage. His task becomes clearer when he discovers that the so-called wealthy suitor is secretly behind the robbery. Cisco must untangle love, deception, and crime to bring justice.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 34, 35, 36
programme.desc: The Wild West adventures of Ben Cartwright and his sons as they run and defend their Nevada ranch while helping the surrounding community.

programme.title: Three Ruthless Ones
programme.desc: The Walker brothers - one a criminal, another a U.S. Marshal, and the third a wealthy rancher - share a lifelong goal: to avenge their father's murder, witnessed as children. When they finally track down the killer, their clashing ideals lead to a dramatic and inevitable showdown, testing family bonds and justice itself.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: Robert Dawson marries Frieda, the German girl responsible for his escape from a prisoner-of-war camp.

programme.title: Goose Steps Out
programme.desc: William Potts, a schoolteacher, happens to be an identical body double for a notorious German Nazi general.

programme.title: Henry V
programme.desc: The King is persuaded by those around him to claim the Crown of France.

programme.title: Conquest of the Air
programme.desc: Charting man's journey towards being able to fly.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: Crimebusters
programme.desc: Two penniless friends decide to rob a store--but end up instead in a police office where they are drafted as new recruits. Starring Terence Hill and Bud Spencer.

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the world of martial arts, there is one man above all: Bruce Lee. San Francisco, 1965.

programme.title: Dominion: The Last Star Warrior
programme.desc: In five days the world changed. As a retired Intelligence agent turned UFO investigator races to discover the fate of the human race, an alien observer searchs for the human woman he loves.

programme.title: The Royal Ring
programme.desc: When the British Museum gets Sidney and Nigel to help search at Tudor sites for a ring of King Henry VIII, Nigel is confronted with his self-confident pestering elder brother Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Set in Stone
programme.desc: In a monastery, Knight Gabriel impales a demon, which then turns to stone. In 2001, Nigel and Sydney arrive bearing a letter from a monk, but the abbot claims it is a forgery and shuts them out.

programme.title: Deadline
programme.desc: Allan comes to Sydney, telling he has 12 hours before a Necron virus kills him unless he delivers Tau to a blackmailer who has the antidote.

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney runs into her ex Gray and goes on a holiday with him to Bali, but when Derek Lloyd shows up to enlist her to find Parvati's Bowl, she can't resist.

programme.title: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydney's roommate from school is on track of a pendant from her past and enlists Sydney to help find it and catch the killer.

programme.title: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 AD: A sheik uses the Light of Truth to reveal his general as a traitor. 2001: Prince Shareem drops out from Sydney's class to go search for the Light of Truth.

programme.title: Obsessed
programme.desc: When successful financial advisor Derek Charles (Idris Elba) settles into a new Los Angeles neighborhood with his loving wife Sharon (Beyonce Knowles) and young son Kyle, everything seems perfect. But when a beautiful temp, Lisa (Ali Larter), joins the firm, Derek's life takes a strange turn. After a misunderstood encounter at the company holiday party, Lisa begins to spiral out of control - putting Derek's career in jeopardy and Sharon's marriage and life on the line.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: Seen from seven different perspectives, the President of the United States - who's really a body double of the prez - is shot during a speech in Madrid, while the real President (in a nearby hotel) is kidnapped by terrorists. Figuring out the terrorists' diversionary tactics and stunned by the betrayal of a fellow American agent, a skittish but brave Secret Service Agent tracks the terrorist leader to find the real president.

programme.title: The Art Of The Steal
programme.desc: Renowned art thief and former daredevil Crunch Calhoun (Kurt Russell) teams up with a motley crew of international grifters to pull off the most elaborate double-crossing caper of a lifetime.

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: When the human race is on the verge of extinction, one of the last survivors on earth, an extraordinary young woman, goes on a mission to track down her younger brother who was abducted by the extra-terrestial creatures colonizing earth.

As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.desc: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Michael Bolton
programme.sub-title: Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without You?", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.title: The Lumineers
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won't be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band's raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Peter Frampton
programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

programme.title: Paris, Wine and Romance
programme.desc: Isabella, la propietaria de la bodega familiar de Oregon, da un gran salto y participa en una prestigiosa competencia de vinos en París. Allí conoce a su mayor competidor, Jacques, de una de las familias vitivinícolas más importantes del mundo.

programme.title: Nieve de verano
programme.desc: Hallie es una niña pequeña con un gran corazón, pero sus formas de ayudar a menudo crean un desastre.

programme.title: Lisboa Story (Historias de Lisboa)
programme.desc: Un cineasta alemán (Patrick Bauchau) pide a un amigo, técnico de sonido, (Rüdiger Vogler) que se reúna con él en Lisboa. Cuando éste llega, el director ha desaparecido, dejando unas cintas con imágenes pero sin sonido. El técnico recorre incansablemente las calles de Lisboa, grabando los sonidos del casco viejo de la ciudad para completar las imágenes grabadas por su amigo.

programme.title: El sabor del sake
programme.desc: Shubei Hirayama es un viudo que vive con su hija de 24 años, sintiéndose viejo y acabado. Shubei se da cuenta de que ella deber…

programme.title: El festín de Babette
programme.desc: 1871. En una remota aldea de pescadores de la costa danesa, dominada por la tradición puritana, dos hermanas solteras recuerdan con nostalgia su lejana juventud. La aparición de Babette, que llega desde París, huyendo del terror, cambiará sus vidas. La recién llegada es acogida como sirvienta y, años después, tendrá ocasión de corresponder a la bondad y al calor con que fue recibida organizando una opulenta cena con los mejores platos y vinos de la gastronomía francesa.

programme.title: El arpa birmana
programme.desc: 1885. Jane Callaghan es una atractiva norteamericana que llega a Rusia para ayudar a Douglas McCraken a conseguir apoyo del Gran Duque para llevar a cabo su más ambicioso invento: una máquina diseñada para talar árboles en Siberia. En plena época de revueltas y traiciones, Jane conoce a Andrey Tolstoy, un joven cadete con el que comparte muchas cosas y que se enamora locamente de ella.

programme.title: El tercer asesinato
programme.desc: El conocido abogado Shigemori defiende a Misumi, acusado de robo con homicidio, que ya cumplió pena de cárcel por otro asesinato hace treinta años.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: 97 Minutos
programme.desc: Un agente infiltrado es la única esperanza de un avión secuestrado a punto de estrellarse.

programme.title: Sweet Home
programme.desc: Alicia sorprende a su novio Simón con una cena romántica para dos en un edificio casi abandonado.

programme.title: Metal Contra Metal
programme.desc: Las luchas épicas de la época medieval se reviven desde Argentina hasta Republica Checa.

programme.title: Paintball: Juega para sobrevivir
programme.desc: Desconocidos deseosos por vivir nuevas experiencias viaja hasta un recóndito lugar de la Europa del este.

programme.title: Duelo en las profundidades
programme.desc: Es el oro de Silas McGee. Aún no lo ha encontrado, aunque lleva más de 30 años buscándolo.

programme.title: La historia interminable
programme.desc: Mientras se esconde de los abusones en el desván del colegio, un chico descubre un mundo extraordinario de fantasía a través de un libro mágico titulado La historia interminable.

programme.title: Fuera de control
programme.desc: Will Graham es un hombre con oscuro pasado, que decide cambiar su vida, pero la desaparición de su hermano le obligará a volver para investigar la verdad de lo sucedido.

programme.title: En el nombre del rey
programme.desc: Película basada en el popular videojuego Dungeon Siege. Historia de corte medieval en la que un granjero de origen humilde consigue convertirse en un heroico y valeroso príncipe que tendrá que salvar su reino de un oscuro y tenebroso final.

programme.title: Invisibles
programme.desc: En Nueva York, un hombre que lo ha perdido todo, incluída su casa, lucha por rehacer su vida, pasando sus días en un refugio para desamparados e intentando contactar con su hija que se ha ido distanciando de él.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: Drama judicial basado en el libro 'History On Trial'. La película cuenta el juicio entre la autora del libro, Deborah E. Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

programme.title: Un gran equipo
programme.desc: Mirco y Fatime son los padres de Jason, un niño con autismo. Cuando la escuela aconseja a la familia de Jason que lo trasladen a una escuela especial, Fatime le pide a Mirco que actúe como padre, ya que no está muy presente en casa porque acostumbra a viajar mucho por motivos de trabajo.

programme.title: Un hombre de familia
programme.desc: Ésta es la emotiva historia de un hombre en busca de la redención. Un empresario de alto nivel (Gerard Butler) recibe la oportunidad de controlar su compañía de trabajo, pero para lograrlo tendrá que poner a su familia de por medio.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry ama a Grace, pero un secreto familiar convierte su historia de amor en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Un romance con Fígaro
programme.desc: Una brillante y joven administradora de fondos, decide dejar atrás su trabajo y su novio de muchos años, para perseguir su sueño de convertirse en cantante de ópera.

programme.title: La lectora
programme.desc: Un novelista ciego tras un accidente de coche en el que también falleció su mujer, redescubre su pasión perdida por la vida y la escritura cuando comienza un romance con la mujer de un hombre de negocios condenado.

programme.title: Nunca es tarde para enamorarse
programme.desc: En Londres para la boda de su hija, Harvey (Dustin Hoffman), un hombre arruinado encuentra su espíritu romántico levantado por una nueva mujer en su vida.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: El club de los martes
programme.desc: Un cambio repentino obliga a Karin a replantearse su vida. Con la ayuda de sus amigos, la comida y su pasión, se niega a aceptar que la vida tenga fecha de caducidad y aprovecha la segunda oportunidad que se le presenta.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Picasso
programme.desc: Ya en su infancia, Pablo Picasso mostró talento por la pintura, y por ello fue enviado a la Academia de Artes de Madrid. Allí se convirtió en pintor, pero se desplazó hasta París, donde vivió en la pobreza. Un día fue descubierto por un millonario y empezó a ganar dinero conociendo de esta manera a gente famosa de los años veinte como Gertrude Stein, Alice B. Toklas, Apollinaire, Hitler y Churchill. El mundo se entregaba al Arte Picasso.

programme.title: Cartas a Roxane
programme.desc: París, 1897, en plena Belle Époque. Edmond Rostand es un dramaturgo prometedor. Pero todo lo que ha escrito ha sido un fracaso…

programme.title: La clase
programme.desc: François y los demás profesores se preparan para enfrentarse a un nuevo curso en un instituto de un barrio conflictivo. Llenos de buenas intenciones, deseosos de aportar la mejor educación a sus alumnos, se arman contra el desaliento. Pero las culturas y las actitudes se enfrentan en el aula, microcosmos de la Francia contemporánea. Por muy divertidos y estimulantes que sean los adolescentes, sus comportamientos pueden cortar de raíz el entusiasmo de un profesor que no cobra bastante. La tremenda franqueza de François sorprende a sus alumnos, pero su estricto sentido de la ética se tambalea cuando los jóvenes empiezan a no aceptar sus métodos.

programme.title: La mujer zurda
programme.desc: Después de pasar unos días sin verse, Marianne se encuentra con Bruno, su marido, y le comunica que deberían separarse. La mujer y su hijo se trasladan a Francia y se instalan en una gran casa medio vacía rodeada de trenes. Allí realiza traducciones para sobrevivir, mientras su calidad de exiliada alemana en un París contemporáneo y hostil la encamina lentamente hacia la locura.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama.

programme.title: Incidencias
programme.desc: Los pasajeros de un tren comienzan a enfrentarse en medio de la nada durante un clima peligroso.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa decide dejarlo todo atrás y tomar las riendas de su vida.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Un romance con Fígaro
programme.desc: Una brillante y joven administradora de fondos, decide dejar atrás su trabajo y su novio de muchos años, para perseguir su sueño de convertirse en cantante de ópera.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: Uncle Drew
programme.desc: Un joven propietario de un equipo y Uncle Drew (Kyrie Irving, estrella de la NBA) reúnen al antiguo equipo de baloncesto de Drew para demostrar que un grupo de septuagenarios todavía puede triunfar.

programme.title: Memorias de un hombre invisible
programme.desc: Un experimento del Gobierno fracasa y vuelve invisible a un testigo casual.

programme.title: El Romance De Murphy
programme.desc: Lo último que Emma Moriarty (Sally Field) esperaba encontrar en Eunice, Arizona, era el amor. Pero cuando ella y su hijo (Corey Haim) se mudan a la ciudad, repentinamente descubre que es objeto de las atenciones de Murphy Jones (Garner) .

programme.title: Peggy Sue se casó
programme.desc: Corre el año 1985. Peggy Sue (Kathleen Turner) es una mujer que está atravesando la dura separación de su marido, Charlie Bodell (Nicolas Cage). Un día recibe una invitación para celebrar junto a sus ex compañeros de instituto los veinticinco años de su graduación escolar. Para ello deciden realizar un baile en el que fuera su instituto. Justo cuando estaban coronando a la Reina de la Noche, la protagonista sufre un mareo y pierde la consciencia. Cuando se despierta percibe que está en el mismo lugar pero que todo está cambiado. Observa que ha vuelto al pasado y que está reviviendo el baile de fin de curso de 1960. Peggy Sue aprovecha la situación para evitar su desgraciado futuro y su infeliz matrimonio junto a Charlie, pero no todo será tan sencillo como piensa, ya que la libertad de los ochenta dista mucho del conservadurismo de los sesenta.

programme.title: Dos Familias Y Una Boda
programme.desc: Dos familias de clases sociales muy diferentes chocan cuando se reúnen para celebrar una boda.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Sonny Koufax (ADAM SANDLER) tiene 32 años y pasó toda su vida evadiendo responsabilidades. Cuando su novia lo deja por un hombre mayor, debe demostrar que está listo para crecer. En un desesperado último esfuerzo, Sonny adopta Julian, de cinco años (COLE SPROUSE, DYLAN SPROUSE) para impresionarla, pero no lo consigue... y no puede devolverlo. ¡Vaya problema para Sony!

programme.title: La quebrada del diablo
programme.desc: Al capitán Viktor Kaleb, desertor del ejército, se le ofrece el indulto y la reincorporación a la caballería si acepta liderar un grupo de fuerzas especiales en una incursión contra un bastión apache en México.

programme.title: Ciccio perdona... ¡Yo no!
programme.desc: Los ladrones de caballos Franco y Ciccio roban sin saberlo un carruaje de oro del temido bandido «El Diablo». Perseguidos, acaban convertidos en héroes en el pueblo de Desolación, mientras el astuto forajido planea recuperar su tesoro. Por suerte, dos pistoleras con gran puntería están dispuestas a ayudar al torpe dúo en esta caótica aventura.

programme.title: La promesa del pistolero
programme.desc: El antiguo sheriff asesina por accidente a un hombre mientras intentaba dar caza al asesino de su familia. Austin promete entregar el cuerpo a la hermana del fallecido y confesar que fue el culpable.

programme.title: The Warrant
programme.desc: Una orden de arresto lleva al alguacil John Breaker y al ayudante Bugle Bearclaw a cruzar el país para entregar a un criminal.

programme.title: Venganza en Cold Cross
programme.desc: El joven forajido William McCarthy busca vengar la traición y asesinato de sus padres. Su camino lo lleva a Cold Cross, sin saber que también es perseguido por el hermano de un sheriff al que mató, desatando un peligroso juego de venganza.

programme.title: ¡Al Ritmo!
programme.desc: Cuando su estrella del pop favorita lanza un concurso de baile online, Mia y Mackie crean su propio equipo para competir en el vídeo mientras su némesis y vecina, Avery, utiliza su encanto y sus recursos para sacar ventaja en la competición.

programme.title: El jardín de la clase media
programme.desc: El cuerpo de una mujer decapitada aparece en la casa de un legislador. Su pareja y un fiscal tratarán de averiguar qué se esconde detrás del crimen, descubriendo una trama mafiosa que implica al poder político.

programme.title: El país de las últimas cosas
programme.desc: En una ciudad en ruinas, una mujer busca a su hermano desaparecido. Adaptación a la gran pantalla de la novela de ciencia ficción de Paul Auster "En el país de las últimas cosas".

programme.title: El candidato
programme.desc: En un estado rural, un hombre de negocios es moldeado por un equipo de campaña para crearle una imagen que lo haga aceptable a los votantes de clase media.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y la estrella celestial
programme.desc: Jack Hunter descubre que el tesoro del faraón fue trasladado a Constantinopla. Reunido con Nadia y Tariq por la NSA, debe impedir que el arma de Osiris caiga en manos criminales, mientras la mafia rusa presiona y pistas lo llevan hasta un convento en Konya vinculado a la Estrella de Osiris.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: El sueño de Valentín
programme.desc: 1960, Buenos Aires. Valentín es un niño de nueve años que vive con su abuela. Su madre desapareció cuando él tenía tres años y su padre es un hombre descontrolado e incapaz de asumir responsabilidades. Valentín es un niño solitario que busca constantemente amor y cariño.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Un grupo de teatro ensaya una versión de 12 hombres sin piedad cuando los interrumpe una alarma. Nos encontramos dentro de la prisión de Quatre Camins y la señal indica el aislamiento de los módulo.

programme.title: El apóstata
programme.desc: Premio FIPRESCI del Festival de San Sebastián 2015. "El apóstata" es una comedia dramática que repasa las cicatrices de un joven que desea emanciparse de aquello que se escapa de su control, a la vez que dispara contra sí mismo y con un afán cínico en algunas cuestiones de fe, de culpa y de deseo.

programme.title: La espina de Dios
programme.desc: Un pequeño grupo de hombres comienza a predicar la próxima venida del Reino. Su líder, el rabí Jesús de Nazaret insufla ilusión en los corazones, su mensaje es de amor y esperanza, aunque no todos supieron comprenderlo.

programme.title: Cub
programme.desc: A camping trip turns into a carnage for a troop of cub scouts as a killer stalks them with deadly traps.

programme.title: Flesh & Blood: The Hammer Heritage of Horror
programme.desc: The history of Hammer Films and their legacy, narrated by the studio's most beloved stars, Peter Cushing and Christopher Lee

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality: The Monster Within and Among Us
programme.desc: Episode One discusses 'The Monster Within And Among Us', and discusses Jack The Ripper (even though he's not American), since he is pretty much the first recognized serial killer. Since a lack of real footage is obvious, this episode uses footage from an old black and white move, loosely based on Jack The Ripper.

programme.title: Antrum: The Deadliest Film Ever Made
programme.desc: A young boy and girl enter the forest to dig a hole to hell. Said to be a cursed film from the late 1970s, Antrum examines the horrifying power of storytelling.

programme.title: Battledogs
programme.desc: Un virus de hombre lobo se desata sobre Nueva York, y el Mayor Hoffman busca una cura mientras el Teniente General Monning quiere establecer un nuevo ejército canino.

programme.title: Breach
programme.desc: A punto de convertirse en padre, un joven mecánico a bordo de un arca interestelar rumbo a la Nueva Tierra debe ingeniárselas para vencer a un terror cósmico maligno que pretende usar la nave espacial como arma.

programme.title: Los Supervivientes
programme.desc: Samuel, un hombre que vive en los Alpes italianos, decide ayudar a Chehreh, una mujer afgana, a llegar a Francia. Tendrán que enfrentarse a una naturaleza hostil y a la crueldad de los hombres que habitan este territorio.

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Durante un asalto a un banco, Rex, un tipo que suele hablar consigo mismo o con su conciencia, detiene a los asaltantes y, tras varios disparos, logra asegurar todo el establecimiento pero, desafortunadamente, toda la misión, a pesar de haber sido un éxito, termina de manera trágica, por lo que es juzgado y encarcelado. Tras cumplir su condena, se muda a Finlandia para tomarse un respiro, pero termina atrapado por una retorcida familia caníbal que esconde un secreto muy oscuro.

programme.title: Junglee: Alma Salvaje
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra vuelve a casa, a la reserva de elefantes de su padre, donde tendrá que luchar contra unos cazadores furtivos.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Pompeya, año 79 d.C. Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Siete guerreros luchan contra Vlad “El Empalador” para salvar a su pueblo en una épica batalla final.

programme.title: Hansan
programme.desc: 1592: el almirante Yi Sun-sin desafía a la armada japonesa con su arma secreta, el barco tortuga.

programme.title: Shorta
programme.desc: Jens y Mike quedan atrapados en un gueto tras una muerte bajo custodia policial ante una turba vengativa.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente británico debe localizar y eliminar a un terrorista suicida y a su célula nacida en el país.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.

programme.title: El Sicario de Dios
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Un escuadrón de pilotos de élite se embarca en una peligrosa misión. Intentan neutralizar un prototipo de avión de combate que está fuera de control y que dispone de un sistema de inteligencia artificial cuyas acciones podrían desencadenar una guerra nuclear.

programme.title: Redada Asesina
programme.desc: En el corazón de los barrios pobres de Yakarta se encuentra un impenetrable bastión de los asesinos y gánsteres más peligrosos del mundo. Hasta ahora, el ruinoso edificio ha sido intocable. Oculto bajo la oscuridad y el silencio de la noche, un equipo de élite debe entrar en la casa para detener al famoso narcotraficante que la gobierna. Pero cuando un encuentro fortuito con un centinela los deja en evidencia y el narcotraficante se entera del asalto, se encontrarán en el sexto piso atrapados sin salida. La unidad deberá luchar contra lo peor de la ciudad para sobrevivir a su misión.
